definition: potential spatial departure location; multiple operators may share one location; current business operations are not asserted
limits: OSM is incomplete; source-supported modeled candidates are not a depot census
address 100m and supplemental campus 1000m are fixed modeling assumptions
OSM object edit dates are not observation or operation dates
private exclusion masks are build inputs and must never be bundled as a public POI layer

public_location_policy.private_road_default_access: ordinary private commercial access admitted as modeled invited-delivery terminal, with authorization assumption explicit and owner consent unobserved; never public through-routing; hard prohibitions, sensitive sites and unsupported barriers remain excluded
public_location_policy.spatial_match: source geometry intersects excluded facility area or buffered sensitive POI

sampling: uniform spatial location first; tier-A-preferred access within location; no area/company/member-count weights

tiers.A: source-supported parcel carrier or dispatch facility proxy
tiers.B: warehouse/logistics facility or ordinary logistics office proxy
tiers.C: generic industrial context only, retail counters, unsupported non-ground office; not candidates

validation.component_scope: road/customer/depot location components; charging/speed rebind, whole CLE and instance activation remain separate
validation.verification_scope: upstream production reference; not a full regeneration from this new repository
